title: Selectable embedding profiles and versioned retrieval indexes
description: Add embedding profiles (default OpenAI text-embedding-3-large; Qwen3 Embedding 4B and 8B served by the existing Ollama), a global default in Settings and a per-paper override. Build versioned, resumable, blue/green indexes per (document, profile, chunk set) through fenced background jobs; unavailable profiles fall back to keyword-only retrieval. Local embedding models join the managed catalog with kind-specific verification.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready document and the default profile, when indexing completes, then every chunk has exactly one embedding for that profile and the index is ready.
Given a duplicate or resumed embed job, when it runs again, then no duplicate embeddings are written and a lost lease cannot write.
Given a paper switched to another profile, when the new index is still building, then retrieval keeps working and the previous ready index stays in use until the new one is ready.
Given a profile without an API key or an uninstalled local model, when a question is asked, then keyword retrieval answers and the reason is visible.
Given a Qwen embedding model, when it is installed through Settings, then its digest, embedding capability and dimensions are verified before use.
test_cases: Embed job idempotency and lease fencing on real Postgres; profile switch state machine; OpenAI and Ollama embedding fixtures; local catalog verification tests.
verification: Agent B (feat/rag-index), TDD per task: continue_locked, retrieval admission slot, embedding profiles and adapters, resumable blue/green embed jobs (yield after 240 s), retrieval and paper-index APIs with request-UUID replay, embedding catalog with pinned digests, embedder context-length check (red: DID NOT RAISE x2), embed jobs linked to papers (red: 2 failed). Agent full run: 474 passed with Ruff clean. Accepted deviation: embed jobs run on the default worker queue instead of a separate retrieval queue.
